workflow_overrides.name: 7/12 Land Record Verification Step
workflow_overrides.rationale: Maharashtra uses the 7/12 land extract as the primary land ownership and crop sown proof. This verification step is Maharashtra-specific as this document format and portal does not exist in other states.

workflow_overrides.name: PoCRA Drought Zone Classification Check
workflow_overrides.rationale: Maharashtra has a designated set of drought-prone districts under PoCRA. An additional classification step is required to determine whether a farmer falls in a PoCRA zone, which affects scheme eligibility. This classification is Maharashtra-specific.

deployment.infrastructure_notes: Urban and semi-urban Maharashtra has good connectivity. Vidarbha and Marathwada regions have variable rural connectivity. Offline mode required for remote village operations.
deployment.onboarding_contact: Commissioner of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra
